source_refs.note: Topic 2.6.1.2 Accessing List Items (PDF 51, printed 48). The printed list has broken quotes and a missing bracket.

blocks.text: You can access items in a list by referring to their index, starting from 0. Example: Access and print the second item from the list of fruits.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The list is printed with curly quotes, an extra quote and no closing bracket (”Apple”, “” Banana”), which is a SyntaxError. It should be fruits = ["Mango", "Apple", "Banana"]; then fruits[1] prints Apple.
Explanation: The code initializes a list 'fruits' containing 'Mango', 'Apple', and 'Banana', then prints the second item, 'Apple', using the index ' 1 '.
